Controls.StartCaptureHint: Draw a free-form polygon over the scene background, then create a transparent Tile.
Controls.AddVertexHint: Add a vertex at the current cursor position while capture is active.
Controls.FinishCaptureHint: Create a Tile from the current polygon selection.
Controls.UndoVertexHint: Remove the most recently added polygon vertex.

OutputFolder.Name: Output folder
OutputFolder.Hint: Choose the destination folder using Foundry's file picker. Generated images will be saved there.
OutputFolder.PickerHint: Open the folder browser to choose the destination.

OutputFormat.Name: Output image format
OutputFormat.Hint: Choose the file format used for newly created Tiles.

VertexMouseButton.Name: Mouse button to add vertices
VertexMouseButton.Hint: Choose which mouse button adds vertices during polygon capture.

FinishMouseButton.Name: Mouse button to finish capture
FinishMouseButton.Hint: Double-click this button to finish the polygon.

UndoMouseButton.Name: Mouse button to undo vertex
UndoMouseButton.Hint: Click to remove the most recently added vertex during capture.

Messages.Instructions: Use the configured mouse button to add vertices and double-click the configured finish button to complete the polygon. Keyboard shortcuts can be changed in Configure Controls.
Messages.Success: Transparent image uploaded and Tile created.
